reverse_net_no_device: No device detected. Connect a device with adb debugging enabled.
reverse_net_awaiting_vpn: Confirm the VPN connection request on the device.
reverse_net_sharing: Reverse net sharing: device traffic flows through this computer.
reverse_net_leak_v6: The device still reaches the internet directly over IPv6 (bypassing the tunnel). Turn off device Wi-Fi or enable airplane mode.
reverse_net_private_dns: Private DNS is enabled, DNS observability and IPv6 leak protection are degraded. Disable Private DNS or switch it to automatic mode.
reverse_net_init_adb: Android SDK Platform Tools not found. Set ANDROID_HOME or install platform-tools in PATH.
